# 07 — Robustness and Counterfactual Probe Analysis (Phase 12)

*Generated by `.scripts/generate_reports.py` from: `results/runs/*/robustness_summary.csv`, `results/runs/*/probes_summary.csv`. Do not edit by hand.*

All perturbations are applied at test time to the 16 kHz recording before each model's own preprocessing; no model is retrained. Up to 600 recordings per test set (stratified, identical for every model and condition). ΔAUC is relative to the clean condition of the same model and test set.
